text_hi: बस वाला बोला रूट बंद है, कब चालू होगा पता नहीं
text_en: The bus driver said the route is closed; nobody knows when it will restart.

text_hi: हाथ तंग है इस महीने
text_en: Her hand is tight this month (a common idiom for being short of money).
rationale: Idiom for money shortage; no explicit money word.

text_hi: बड़े भैया जब तक हां न कहें, कहीं नहीं जाती
text_en: She does not go anywhere until her elder brother says yes.
rationale: Needs family permission (brother, a relation not used for permission in training).

text_hi: पति साथ गए थे पिछली बार, इस बार भी जाएंगे
text_en: Her husband went with her last time and will go this time too.
rationale: Husband mentioned as support; no barrier. Adversarial.

text_hi: डाक्टर के पास जाने के नाम से कांपने लगती है
text_en: She starts trembling at the very mention of going to the doctor.
rationale: Fear expressed without the usual fear words; spelling variant of doctor.

text_hi: कटाई खतम होते ही जाएगी, अभी फुरसत नहीं
text_en: She will go as soon as the harvest is over; no time right now.

text_hi: उसे लगा बात खत्म, दवा जो मिल गई
text_en: She thought the matter was over since she got medicine.

text_hi: पैसा नहीं है, डर कोई नहीं
text_en: There is no money; no fear at all.
rationale: Money barrier; fear explicitly denied. Negation trap.

text_hi: मायके गई हुई है, लौटकर बात करेंगे
text_en: She has gone to her parents' home; will talk when she returns.
rationale: Family word but only absence; no barrier. Adversarial.

text_hi: छोटे वाले को बुखार है, उसे छोड़ नहीं सकती अभी
text_en: The little one has a fever; she cannot leave him right now.

text_hi: सरपंच से गाड़ी मांगी थी, नहीं मिली
text_en: She asked the sarpanch for a vehicle and did not get one.

text_hi: लोग क्या सोचेंगे, ये बात उसे खाए जा रही है
text_en: What people will think is eating away at her.

text_hi: काम भी, पैसा भी, सब दिक्कत है
text_en: Work, money, everything is a problem.
rationale: Fragmentary note listing work and money.

text_hi: ASHA ने समझाया फिर भी बोली जरूरत नही
text_en: The ASHA explained, yet she said there is no need.
rationale: Does not see the need; misspelling. Could be hesitancy; review.

text_hi: पति परदेस में, सास बीमार, सब उसी पे
text_en: Husband is away in another state, mother-in-law is ill, everything is on her.
rationale: Caregiving load. Husband's absence is not stated as a barrier to going, so household is 0. Review.

text_hi: ससुराल वाले बोले जांच-वांच कुछ नहीं, और उसे भी डर है
text_en: The in-laws said no tests or anything of the sort, and she is scared too.

text_hi: रास्ते में नाला है, बारिश में रास्ता बंद, और पति भी इजाजत नहीं देंगे
text_en: There is a stream on the way, the road closes in the rain, and her husband will not give permission either.

text_hi: कब जाना था भूल गई, और खेत भी देखना है
text_en: She forgot when she was supposed to go, and she has to look after the field too.

text_hi: बोली भगवान की मर्जी, जो होगा देखा जाएगा
text_en: She said it is God's will; whatever happens will be seen.
rationale: Fatalistic belief treated as hesitancy. Review.

text_hi: अस्पताल में डॉक्टर की कमी है ऐसा सुना है
text_en: She has heard that the hospital is short of doctors.
rationale: Supply-side hearsay; no personal reluctance or barrier stated. Outside taxonomy. Review.

text_hi: पैसे की बात नहीं, बस साथ जाने वाला चाहिए
text_en: It is not about money; she just needs someone to go with her.
rationale: Accompaniment need; money explicitly ruled out. Negation trap.

text_hi: kiraya nai h
text_en: No fare.

text_hi: ghrwale mana kr rhe
text_en: The family is refusing.

text_hi: report dekh ke bahut ghabra rahi thi
text_en: She was very anxious after seeing the report.

text_hi: dihadi ka nuksan hoga
text_en: There will be a loss of daily wages.

text_hi: wahan jaake kisse milna hai, kuch idea nahi usko
text_en: She has no idea whom to meet after getting there.

text_hi: kal koi mila nahi
text_en: Did not meet anyone yesterday.

text_hi: pati le jayenge, paise ka intezam hai
text_en: Her husband will take her; the money is arranged.
rationale: Husband and money mentioned as resolved. Adversarial.

text_hi: saas ki seva, bachche, khet... time hi nahi
text_en: Caring for her mother-in-law, the children, the field... no time at all.

text_hi: dar to hai par jayegi
text_en: She is scared but she will go.
rationale: Fear is expressed even though she intends to go; labels capture stated barriers.

text_hi: door bahut h aur akele nahi jaa sakti
text_en: It is very far and she cannot go alone.

text_hi: is month budget nahi hai
text_en: There is no budget this month.

text_hi: in-laws allow nahi kar rahe
text_en: The in-laws are not allowing it.

text_hi: hospital ko leke anxiety hai
text_en: She has anxiety about the hospital.

text_hi: shift duty hai, off nahi milta
text_en: She has shift duty and does not get a day off.

text_hi: usko laga follow up optional hai
text_en: She thought the follow-up was optional.

text_hi: sab theek hai, next visit pe confirm karenge
text_en: All is fine; will confirm on the next visit.

text_hi: money problem + child ko koi dekhne wala nahi
text_en: Money problem, and nobody to look after the child.

text_hi: husband की permission है, बस date fix करनी है
text_en: Her husband has given permission; just need to fix a date.

text_hi: उसे लगता है report normal है, और travel का खर्च भी
text_en: She thinks the report is normal, and there is the travel cost too.
